description: Key facts a correct lesson on each Petroleum Refining and Petrochemicals topic must state. Every fact was taken from the fetched text of the source page named with it (the quote is checked by `npm run golden:check`). Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions matched against the lesson text after LaTeX backslashes and braces are removed.
subject: petroleum-refining
